control_protocol.handshake: ctrl_valid && ctrl_ready accepts one immutable transaction. ctrl_ready remains low until an actual destination response returns; caller must wait or retain valid/payload as in ready/valid. ctrl_done is one source-clock pulse with matching ctrl_done_op and ctrl_error.

operations.1: WRITE: ctrl_data one ordered 64-bit HV word
operations.2: COMMIT: done only after core commit_ack at a safe boundary with no pinned playback

control_protocol.status: ctrl_loaded and ctrl_active_valid are response-associated snapshots, not unsynchronized live signals. No success if the core rejects length/CRC/state/op.
control_protocol.throughput: One outstanding mailbox transaction; appropriate for preload, not a continuous waveform data path

cdc.architecture: 130-bit request and5-bit response bundled-data toggle mailboxes; payload remains stable until synchronized destination acknowledgement; two ASYNC_REG control synchronizer stages each way
cdc.reset: One common active-low reset asserts all domains; each domain releases through its own two-stage synchronizer. Reset cancels inflight transaction and invalidates active AWG. Wrapper outputs force zero/invalid immediately on common reset even if sample clock is stopped.
cdc.physical_gate: Bundled payload paths require validated placement/routing delay bounds relative to destination request synchronization. Functional simulation is not a metastability proof. No timing waiver/false-path exception was inserted; report_cdc must be reviewed in top-level context.
cdc.source_stability: Mailbox captures payload at accepted ctrl edge; caller changes afterward cannot tear destination command or sample
cdc.destination_capture: Each mailbox captures the complete held payload into destination-clock registers before asserting dst_valid. Those registers are preserved to prevent optimization moving cross-domain data paths into RAM or operation decode.

sample_interface: safe_boundary/play synchronous clk_rf; active_valid/playing/out_valid/out_last/out_data synchronous clk_rf with reset masking; uses unchanged AWG core

verification.icarus: PASS three independent clock ratios (half periods5/4,3/7,7/3ns), payload mutation, CRC failure, invalid state/op, deferred completion, playback, reset cancellation

cdc_report.interpretation: 4 recognized two-stage control synchronizers;135 held-data bits captured by destination clock enables. Must prove bundled payload physical timing in top-level; warnings not waived.

not_implemented: physical RF enable or analog calibration
